verdict.rationale: ByteAsk can join a live process through a bridge started in the user's gdb session. It reads the live state, asks before changing anything, and hands back frames, files and line numbers. That covers live debugging from the assistant, but only for C/C++ programs under gdb, with nothing specific to web applications. Missing for 10: any evidence of debugging web apps specifically (browser/JS runtimes, HTTP request inspection, web frameworks), support beyond C/C++ and gdb, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the live-attach flow.
